items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: I just got some pointers from old man Contra.

ctx.x: Well uh when was your birthday? When were you born? Uh February 23rd, 1904. February 23rd? 1904. Same as me, February 23rd.

The 23rd February? Yeah. Uh so who taught you to play? Well I didn't exactly I just got some pointers from old man Contra. I just picked up. I just picked up drums myself around the house like that. You know. Yeah. I was listening to old time uh Grafenolis in the piano. It was called me and the players. Oh man. I picked that up like that beatin' on a table or something like. Quite like these but you know this. Oh man. Instead of take my foot pat on the floor there with two forks or even two drumsticks. Oh man.
